# Overview

Tube labels appear in several formats — the site–coral separator (underscore or none), the order of timepoint and replicate, and the replicate prefix (`R` or zero-padded) all vary:

| Variant | Format | Example |
|---------|--------|---------|
| underscore, timepoint first, R-prefix | `{site}_{coral}_{timepoint}_R{rep}` | `JC_40_T0_R1` |
| no underscore, timepoint first, R-prefix | `{site}{coral}_{timepoint}_R{rep}` | `JC40_T2_R1` |
| underscore, rep first, R-prefix | `{site}_{coral}_R{rep}_{timepoint}` | `JC_40_R1_T0` |
| underscore, rep first, zero-padded | `{site}_{coral}_0{rep}_{timepoint}` | `JC_40_01_T0` |

All variants are parsed into their components and four `colony_id` columns are generated — one for each format that may appear in downstream datasheets:

| Column | Format | Example | Where used |
|--------|--------|---------|------------|
| `colony_id` | `{site}_{coral}_{rep_pad}_{timepoint}` | `JC_40_01_T0` | platemaps (chlorophyll, protein) |
| `colony_id_tp_R` | `{site}_{coral}_{timepoint}_R{rep}` | `JC_40_T0_R1` | homogenate vols, surface area |
| `colony_id_tp_pad` | `{site}_{coral}_{timepoint}_{rep_pad}` | `JC_40_T0_01` | timepoint-first, zero-padded variant |
| `colony_id_R_tp` | `{site}_{coral}_R{rep}_{timepoint}` | `JC_40_R1_T0` | rep-first, R-prefix variant |

Join downstream datasheets to this table using whichever column matches the format recorded on the tubes.

# Read sample info

```{r read}
sample_info <- read_csv("data/master_sample_info.csv") 
```

# Create colony_id

A helper function tries both field orders and both replicate prefixes (`R` or zero-padded `0`), then coalesces the results.

```{r transform}
# Parse site / coral / timepoint / rep from a vector of raw IDs.
# Handles two field orders and two rep-prefix styles:
#   Pattern A (timepoint before rep): site_?coral_timepoint_[R|0]rep
#   Pattern B (rep before timepoint): site_?coral_[R|0]rep_timepoint
parse_id <- function(x) {
  mA <- str_match(x, "^([A-Z]+)_?([0-9]+)_(T[0-9]+)_[R0]?([0-9]+)$")
  mB <- str_match(x, "^([A-Z]+)_?([0-9]+)_[R0]?([0-9]+)_(T[0-9]+)$")
  tibble(
    site      = coalesce(mA[, 2], mB[, 2]),
    coral     = coalesce(mA[, 3], mB[, 3]),
    timepoint = coalesce(mA[, 4], mB[, 5]),
    rep       = coalesce(mA[, 5], mB[, 4])
  )
}

sample_info <- sample_info %>%
  bind_cols(parse_id(.$original_id)) %>%
  mutate(
    rep_n        = as.integer(rep),
    rep_pad      = sprintf("%02d", rep_n),
    # Canonical: rep-first, zero-padded — matches platemaps
    colony_id        = paste(site, coral, rep_pad,             timepoint, sep = "_"),
    # Timepoint-first, R-prefix — e.g. homogenate vols, surface area
    colony_id_tp_R   = paste(site, coral, timepoint, paste0("R", rep_n), sep = "_"),
    # Timepoint-first, zero-padded
    colony_id_tp_pad = paste(site, coral, timepoint, rep_pad,             sep = "_"),
    # Rep-first, R-prefix
    colony_id_R_tp   = paste(site, coral, paste0("R", rep_n), timepoint,  sep = "_")
  ) %>%
  select(-rep_n, -rep_pad)
```

# Spot-check

One row per timepoint to verify the transformation.

```{r spot-check}
sample_info %>%
  group_by(monitoring) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  select(original_id, colony_id, colony_id_tp_R, colony_id_tp_pad, colony_id_R_tp, monitoring)
```

# Check for parse failures

Any rows where the regex did not match will have `NA` in `colony_id`.

```{r check-na}
failures <- sample_info %>% filter(is.na(colony_id))

if (nrow(failures) == 0) {
  cat("No parse failures — all", nrow(sample_info), "rows matched successfully.\n")
} else {
  warning(nrow(failures), " row(s) failed to parse:")
  print(failures)
}
```

Check for duplicates
```{r}
# Check for duplicate original_id in sample_info
dupes <- sample_info %>% filter(duplicated(original_id))
if (nrow(dupes) > 0) {
  warning(nrow(dupes), " duplicate original_id(s) found in sample_info:")
  print(dupes)
} else {
  cat("No duplicate original_ids found in sample_info.\n")
}

```


# Write output

```{r write}
write_csv(sample_info, "data/sample_info_colony_id.csv")
cat("Saved", nrow(sample_info), "rows to data/sample_info_colony_id.csv\n")
```
